takeaways.cover: They have to be here for the talent. They want to be in the office. Tour the vacant LS product that already has power.
takeaways.markets: Four geos only. SF 29.2%. Peninsula 24.9%. Greater SV office 15.2% / R&D 13.3%. Oakland office 25.7%.
takeaways.rnd: 135.2 msf. 13.3% vacant. +519k in Q2. Asking $2.84/sf NNN. 940k under construction.
takeaways.leasing: Demand died after the COVID build. 30.2% vacant. The leftover shells are the AI inventory — if the MEP is real.
takeaways.office: Peninsula office is 24.9% vacant. That is not the AI product. Talent still comes to the office.
takeaways.exploding: AI is 1.1 msf of 4.0 msf Peninsula TIMS. Remote listings are 7%. They will sit in the building.
takeaways.power: High-powered AI tenant: 30 W/SF min, prefer 35–50+. Excess transformer and 40% backup.
takeaways.funding: 80% of U.S. AI VC since 2020 lands here. LS funding is the residual.
takeaways.mission-bay: 17.0% vacant. $9.33/sf FSG. Tour 1450 Owens. OpenAI rent at 550 Terry is confidential.
takeaways.inventory: Tour the vacant new-construction LS shells and 1450 Owens. 150 Industrial is a closed deal. Mission Rock B is signed.
takeaways.decision: What do you tour this quarter — and does it already have the MEP?

takeaways.cover: Vacant high-infrastructure R&D is the conversion bid. Commodity office is not.
takeaways.markets: Core geos still carry the vacancy. Growth geos are tighter on office and R&D.
takeaways.rnd: Sunnyvale and West Valley are tight. Palo Alto and SJ North still have the empty boxes.
takeaways.leasing: 30.2% Bay Area science vacant. The paper that printed is still purpose-built. The empty shells are the AI tour.
takeaways.office: 24.9% Peninsula vacancy does not become an AI bid without power and MEP.
takeaways.exploding: AI companies require in-person. 30% of SF office activity since 2023 is AI-related.
takeaways.power: Hold or convert only if 30 W/SF and transformer excess exist. That is the sale against vacant LS shells.
takeaways.funding: Office investment $9.091B is not lease-up. 80% of AI VC is the demand signal.
takeaways.mission-bay: Q2 office vacancy is 17.0%, not 22.7%. 1450 Owens is the vacant cold shell. NVIDIA is chatter.
takeaways.inventory: Vacant new-construction shells are the overbuild. 1450 Owens is the Mission Bay tour. Do not list 150 Industrial or Mission Rock B as vacant.
takeaways.decision: Hold, convert, or sell into the user who already printed at 150 Industrial.

takeaways.cover: Credit follows in-office AI and power delivery — not vacancy averages.
takeaways.markets: SF took +964k in Q2. Peninsula gave back 138k. Mission Bay gave back 151k on a large tech sublease.
takeaways.rnd: +519k in the quarter. YTD is still −1.14 msf. 940k UC, not the 1.26 msf preleased pipeline note.
takeaways.leasing: 16-year UCSF paper and a vacant CGT shell are not the same credit.
takeaways.office: Peninsula office gave back 138k SF. In-office AI is not a takeout for every empty floor.
takeaways.exploding: 375,730 tech workers. NY Metro is larger on headcount. The Bay Area is still #1 on the scorecard — and 80% of AI VC.
takeaways.power: Underwrite 30 W/SF min and 40% backup. May power vintage is older — do not lend as if it is the Q2 snapshot.
takeaways.funding: $47.42B Q4 venture. LS $2.7B is residual. Debt thaw is not occupancy.
takeaways.mission-bay: 17.0% vacant. $9.33/sf FSG. −150,979 in the quarter on a large tech sublease. NVIDIA is chatter, not a closed-comp print.
takeaways.inventory: 1450 Owens is 215k vacant at $7.75/sf NNN. 150 Industrial is leased robotics. Mission Rock B has Coinbase signed.
takeaways.decision: Where do you put debt this quarter — and on whose delivery clock?
